'''Puttie''' was a sport played throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was considered by many [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] to be very boring.<ref name="Children">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
A [[Puttie Course]] was operated on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] during its construction.<ref name="TDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
